label: round-5 preregistration (paper-runtime simulated-port arm), written after rounds 1-4 and before any round-5 command ran; dispatched as a continuation of this unit
why: The remaining paper-runtime telemetry clause was deferred to sota-workflow-resolution because the real paper runner (runner.py main/scheduled_trial.sh) loads Alpaca paper credentials and calls the broker, both prohibited for this unit. The wave's rule requires checking an isolated alternative before deferring: the same runtime's native path (runner.run_native: NautilusTrader 2.0.0rc5 node, AdaptiveStrategy, Controller, SQLite WAL Ledger journal) runs against the repository's synthetic SimulatedPort with no network or credentials. This round runs it as a Dagu step inside srt.
workload: Dagu 2.16.6 DAG obsgap-paper: step paper-runtime = srt(settings: no allowed domains, allowWrite only the work dir, denyRead a planted decoy dir) running paper_sim_workload.py for 30 s then three probes (egress to example.com, write outside allowWrite, read the decoy); parallel step hot-backup = restic backup of the live journal dir about 12 s into the run. Telemetry: Dagu native otel spans (spanmetrics) plus the step log file (runtime event JSON lines) via otelcol-contrib filelog, and a count connector turning runtime log records into Prometheus series; Loki stores the lines.
expectation: paper_sim_end status passed with native_fill_events > 0 and flat true; Prometheus holds span series for the DAG and both steps and a nonzero paper log-record count series; Loki holds the MARK lines including paper_sim_end; both survive kill -9 and restart and are served from restic-restored stores; restic check --read-data and restore --verify pass; the cold restore of work dir and DAGU_HOME is byte-identical and the restored journal passes PRAGMA integrity_check with table counts equal to paper_sim_end journal_counts; the hot snapshot's journal also passes integrity_check (counts may be lower, reported not asserted); all three sandbox probes are denied while the unsandboxed controls succeed; all listeners are 127.0.0.1 and 0 processes/listeners remain.

criteria.advanced: every assertion above passes; the gap outcome stays advanced because this is a synthetic broker port (no real paper-account telemetry, no real order journal from a broker session), which remains owned by sota-workflow-resolution, and the ledger re-judgement stays with the coordinator
criteria.detection: in-script PASS/FAIL lines; sandbox probes print PROBE lines with exit codes and the srt debug deny line, with unsandboxed controls that must succeed so a broken sandbox would show as a FAIL; restore fidelity by diff -rq and sqlite counts
criteria.not_settled_or_failure: any FAIL is reported as observed; a run exceeding 20 minutes is stopped and recorded as not_settled
